remarks: Experience elevated living in this renovated, move-in-ready Penthouse-a coveted end-unit boasting breathtaking views. Designed for both comfort and sophistication, this light-filled, open-concept residence features a sleek white kitchen with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a stylish breakfast bar, seamlessly flowing into the expansive living and dining area. The primary suite has been freshly painted and showcases brand-new hardwood flooring, a spacious walk-in closet, and an en-suite bath with a tub/shower combination. Step onto your private balcony from both the living area and primary suite, offering a tranquil escape in the heart of the city. Notable features include an updated half bath, Central Air conditioning, hardwood flooring throughout & In-unit laundry. Located in the desirable Washington Heights, residents enjoy top-tier amenities, including a fully equipped fitness center, his-and-her saunas, and secured reserved garage parking. This elevator-accessible, pet-friendly building is ideally positioned near Scalzi Park, offering playgrounds, bocce ball courts, a skate park, and scenic walking paths. Just minutes from Ridgeway Shopping Plaza, acclaimed restaurants, and public transportation, this penthouse is the perfect blend of convenience & effortless living.
